'''High Festival''' was an annual event observed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Saheelindeel]]. High Festival originally celebrated for the tribal gatherings and ritual hunts, it later became a ceremony evoking fertility and a good harvest. Over time, it would eventually deteriorate into a marketable circus, featuring an air show and an industrial fair. The fair brought in new technologies from the [[Tion Hegemony/Legends|Tion Hegemony]], helping to further industrialize the planet.
